q: Quantum advantage for sampling problems (like BosonSampling and random circuit sampling) is related to the hardness of computing:
opts: The permanent of a matrix (BosonSampling) or amplitudes of random circuits
exp: BosonSampling (Aaronson-Arkhipov): sampling from the output distribution of a boson interferometer is hard for classical computers unless the polynomial hierarchy collapses, based on the hardness of computing matrix permanents. Random circuit sampling has analogous hardness.
